name: Citalopram
summary: Citalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressant.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 mediate N-demethylation to demethylcitalopram, followed by further metabolism. Metabolites are substantially less potent than the parent; unchanged drug and metabolites contribute to urinary elimination.
